WITH blocked AS (
    SELECT ba.area_id, ba.restrict_type, ba.penalty_w
    FROM fn_blocked_areas_from_admin(p_now, p_gender, p_mode, p_floor) ba
  ),
  door_stats AS (
    SELECT
      a.id       AS area_id,
      COUNT(d.*) AS door_cnt
    FROM areas a
    LEFT JOIN doors d
      ON d.floor = a.floor
     AND (d.from_area = a.id OR d.to_area = a.id)
    WHERE a.floor = p_floor
    GROUP BY a.id
  )
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.geom,
    a.area_type,
    a.floor,
    a.allowed_gender,
    a.is_closed,
    a.weight_open_space,
    a.attrs,
    CASE
      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- 1) wheelchair: پله همیشه ممنوع
      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      WHEN p_mode = 'wheelchair'
           AND a.area_type = 'stair_area' THEN FALSE

      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- 2) اگر فضای معمولی است و هیچ دری ندارد → غیرمجاز
      --   ولی stair/ramp/elevator از این قانون مستثنا هستند
      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      WHEN a.area_type NOT IN ('stair_area','ramp_area','elevator_area')
           AND COALESCE(ds.door_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN FALSE

      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- 3) محدودیت‌های ادمین
      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      WHEN b.area_id IS NULL THEN (NOT a.is_closed)
      WHEN b.restrict_type = 'close' THEN FALSE
      ELSE (NOT a.is_closed)
    END AS is_allowed,
    COALESCE(b.penalty_w, 0.0) AS admin_penalty_w
  FROM areas a
  LEFT JOIN blocked    b  ON b.area_id = a.id
  LEFT JOIN door_stats ds ON ds.area_id = a.id
  WHERE a.floor = p_floor
    AND (
      p_gender = 'both'            -- یعنی اصلاً فیلتر جنسیتی نکن
      OR a.allowed_gender = 'both'
      OR a.allowed_gender = p_gender
    );

BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH area_sel AS (
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) انتخاب محدوده‌ای که نقطه را پوشش می‌دهد (یا با آن متقاطع است)
    --    اگر چندتا بود، کوچک‌ترین مساحت انتخاب می‌شود.
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
      a.id,
      a.geom,
      fn_i18n_label('areas', a.id, 'name', p_lang, 'fa') AS name,
      ST_Centroid(a.geom) AS center
    FROM areas a
    WHERE a.floor = p_floor
      AND ST_Intersects(a.geom, p_point)
    ORDER BY ST_Area(a.geom) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ),

  doors_raw AS (
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) درب‌های متصل به این محدوده از door_access_points
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
      dap.id        AS access_id,
      dap.door_id,
      dap.geom,
      dap.floor,
      dap.from_area,
      dap.to_area,
      asel.id       AS area_id,
      asel.geom     AS area_geom,
      asel.name     AS area_name,
      asel.center,
      ST_Azimuth(asel.center, dap.geom) AS az
    FROM door_access_points dap
    JOIN area_sel asel
      ON dap.floor = p_floor
     AND (dap.from_area = asel.id OR dap.to_area = asel.id)
  ),

  doors_angle AS (
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) محاسبهٔ زاویه نسبت به شمال‌غرب محدوده
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
      dr.*,
      CASE
        WHEN dr.az >= 7 * pi() / 4.0
          THEN dr.az - 7 * pi() / 4.0       -- از NW تا 2π
        ELSE dr.az + 2 * pi() - 7 * pi() / 4.0  -- از 0 تا NW
      END AS angle_from_nw
    FROM doors_raw dr
  ),

  ordered AS (
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) شماره‌گذاری درب‌ها به صورت ساعت‌گرد از شمال‌غرب
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
      da.*,
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY da.angle_from_nw) AS door_no
    FROM doors_angle da
    ORDER BY da.angle_from_nw
  )

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5) خروجی نهایی با برچسب «از / به»
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT
    o.area_id,
    o.area_name,
    o.area_geom,
    o.door_no::int AS door_no,      -- 👈 اینجا CAST اضافه شد
    o.door_id,
    o.access_id,
    o.geom AS door_geom,

    o.to_area        AS to_area_id,

    fn_i18n_label('areas', o.to_area, 'name', p_lang, 'fa')   AS to_area_name,

    -- محدودهٔ دیگر (آن طرف درب)
    CASE
      WHEN o.from_area = o.area_id THEN o.to_area
      ELSE o.from_area
    END AS other_area_id,

    CASE
      WHEN o.from_area = o.area_id THEN
        fn_i18n_label('areas', o.to_area, 'name', p_lang, 'fa')
      ELSE
        fn_i18n_label('areas', o.from_area, 'name', p_lang, 'fa')
    END AS other_area_name,

    -- متن نهایی: «درب شماره N از [محدوده فعلی] به [محدوده دیگر]»
    CASE
      WHEN o.from_area = o.area_id THEN
        format(
          E'درب شماره %s از %s به %s',
          o.door_no,
          o.area_name,
          COALESCE(
            fn_i18n_label('areas', o.to_area, 'name', p_lang, 'fa'),
            'نامشخص'
          )
        )
      WHEN o.to_area = o.area_id THEN
        format(
          E'درب شماره %s از %s به %s',
          o.door_no,
          o.area_name,
          COALESCE(
            fn_i18n_label('areas', o.from_area, 'name', p_lang, 'fa'),
            'نامشخص'
          )
        )
      ELSE
        format(E'درب شماره %s', o.door_no)
    END AS door_label
  FROM ordered o;
END;

WITH doors AS (
  -- خروجی کامل از تابع قبلی
  SELECT *
  FROM fn_area_doors_clockwise(p_point, p_floor, p_lang)
),

area_info AS (
  -- فقط یک area (همونی که انتخاب شده)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    area_id,
    area_name,
    area_geom,
    ST_Transform(area_geom, 4326)          AS geom4326,
    ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(area_geom), 4326) AS centroid4326,
    ST_Area(area_geom)                     AS area_m2
  FROM doors
),

area_json AS (
  SELECT
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id',        area_id,
      'name',      area_name,
      'floor',     p_floor,
      'areaM2',    area_m2,
      'coord32640',
        jsonb_build_array(
          ST_X(ST_Centroid(area_geom)),
          ST_Y(ST_Centroid(area_geom))
        ),
      'coord4326',
        jsonb_build_array(
          ST_X(centroid4326),
          ST_Y(centroid4326)
        ),
      'bbox4326',
        jsonb_build_array(
          ST_XMin(geom4326),
          ST_YMin(geom4326),
          ST_XMax(geom4326),
          ST_YMax(geom4326)
        ),
      -- هندسه کامل محدوده برای رسم روی نقشه (GeoJSON 4326)
      'geometry',
        ST_AsGeoJSON(geom4326)::jsonb
    ) AS area
  FROM area_info
),

doors_json AS (
  SELECT
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'doorNo',       door_no,
        'doorId',       door_id,
        'accessId',     access_id,
        'label',        door_label,
        'fromAreaId',   from_area_id,

        'toAreaName',   to_area_name,
        'otherAreaId',  other_area_id,
        'otherAreaName',other_area_name,
        'coord32640',
          jsonb_build_array(
            ST_X(door_geom),
            ST_Y(door_geom)
          ),
        'coord4326',
          jsonb_build_array(
            ST_X(ST_Transform(door_geom, 4326)),
            ST_Y(ST_Transform(door_geom, 4326))
          )
      )
      ORDER BY door_no
    ) AS doors
  FROM doors
)

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'area',  (SELECT area  FROM area_json),
  'doors', COALESCE((SELECT doors FROM doors_json), '[]'::jsonb)
);

DECLARE
  tile_bbox_3857   geometry;  -- bbox تایل در 3857
  tile_bbox_32640  geometry;  -- همان bbox در SRID داده‌ها
BEGIN
  -- bbox تایل در WebMercator
  tile_bbox_3857 := ST_TileEnvelope(z, x, y);

  -- تبدیل bbox به سیستم مختصات داده‌ها (32640)
  tile_bbox_32640 := ST_Transform(tile_bbox_3857, 32640);

  RETURN (
    SELECT ST_AsMVT(t, 'areas', 4096, 'geom')
    FROM (
      SELECT
        ST_AsMVTGeom(
          ST_Transform(a.geom, 3857),  -- تبدیل داده‌ها به 3857 برای MVT
          tile_bbox_3857,              -- bbox در همان 3857
          4096,
          64,
          true
        ) AS geom,
        a.id,
        a.area_type,

  v_steps_doors   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_sahns         jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_via_points    jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;

  v_start_4326    geometry(Point, 4326);
  v_end_4326      geometry(Point, 4326);

  v_speed_mps     numeric;
BEGIN
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1) متریک‌ها
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_distance_m := ST_Length(p_geom);

  v_speed_mps :=
    CASE p_mode
      WHEN 'walk'       THEN 1.2
      WHEN 'wheelchair' THEN 1.0
      WHEN 'van'        THEN 5.0
      ELSE 1.2
    END;

  v_estimated_min := (v_distance_m / v_speed_mps) / 60.0;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2) sahns: توالی صحن‌ها به ترتیب پیشروی روی مسیر
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  WITH route AS (
    SELECT p_geom AS geom
  ),
  sahn_areas AS (
    SELECT
      a.id,
      a.geom,
      COALESCE(t.txt, format('area %s', a.id)) AS name
    FROM areas a
    LEFT JOIN i18n_texts t
      ON t.entity_table = 'areas'
     AND t.entity_id   = a.id
     AND t.field       = 'name'
     AND t.lang        = p_lang
    WHERE a.area_type = 'courtyard'
      AND a.floor      = p_floor
  ),
  sahn_hits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      s.id,
      s.name,
      -- نقطه‌ی نزدیک مسیر (centroid را به نزدیک‌ترین نقطه روی مسیر می‌چسبانیم)
      ST_LineLocatePoint(
        p_geom,
        ST_ClosestPoint(p_geom, ST_Centroid(s.geom))
      ) AS pos
    FROM route r
    JOIN sahn_areas s
  ON ST_Intersects(r.geom, s.geom)
 AND ST_Length(ST_Intersection(r.geom, s.geom)) > 2
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'areaId', id,
               'name',   name
             )
             ORDER BY pos
           ),
           '[]'::jsonb
         )
  INTO v_sahns
  FROM sahn_hits;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3) viaPoints ساده بر اساس sahns
  --------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
      SELECT COALESCE(
               jsonb_agg(
                 jsonb_build_object(
                   'type',    'sahn',
                   'refType', 'area',
                   'refId',   (s->>'areaId')::bigint,
                   'name',    s->>'name'
                 )
               ),
               '[]'::jsonb
             )
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_sahns) AS s
    );

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4) گام‌ها: start / doors / end
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_start_4326 := ST_Transform(ST_StartPoint(p_geom), 4326)::geometry(Point, 4326);
  v_end_4326   := ST_Transform(ST_EndPoint(p_geom),   4326)::geometry(Point, 4326);

    -- 4-1) گام‌های درب‌ها روی مسیر
  WITH route AS (
  SELECT p_geom AS geom
),
door_pts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.id,
    d.modes,
    ST_ClosestPoint(p_geom, ST_LineInterpolatePoint(d.geom, 0.5))::geometry(Point, 32640) AS pt_32640
  FROM doors d
  JOIN route r
    ON d.floor = p_floor
   AND ST_Length(ST_Intersection(r.geom, ST_Buffer(d.geom, 0.15))) > 0.05
),
door_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    dp.id,
    dp.modes,
    dp.pt_32640,
    ST_LineLocatePoint(p_geom, dp.pt_32640) AS m
  FROM door_pts dp
)
  SELECT COALESCE(
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'type',  'stepPassDoor',
               'title', COALESCE(t.txt, format('Door %s', d.id)),
               'coord', jsonb_build_object(

                             'wheelchair',  ('wheelchair' = ANY(d.modes)),
                             'electricVan', ('van'        = ANY(d.modes))
                           ),
               'doorId', d.id
             )
             ORDER BY d.m
           ),
           '[]'::jsonb
         )
  INTO v_steps_doors
  FROM door_ordered d
  LEFT JOIN i18n_texts t
    ON t.entity_table = 'doors'
   AND t.entity_id   = d.id
   AND t.field       = 'name'
   AND t.lang        = p_lang;


  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4-2) گام شروع
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_steps :=
    jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'type',  'stepPassConnection',
        'title', 'شروع حرکت',
        'coord', jsonb_build_object(
                   'lon', ST_X(v_start_4326),
                   'lat', ST_Y(v_start_4326)
                 ),
        'services', jsonb_build_object(
                      'walking',     (p_mode = 'walk'),
                      'wheelchair',  (p_mode = 'wheelchair'),
                      'electricVan', (p_mode = 'van')
                    )
      )
    );

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4-3) اضافه کردن گام‌های درب
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_steps := v_steps || v_steps_doors;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4-4) گام پایان
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_steps :=
    v_steps || jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'type',  'stepArriveDestination',
        'title', 'رسیدن به مقصد',
        'coord', jsonb_build_object(
                   'lon', ST_X(v_end_4326),
                   'lat', ST_Y(v_end_4326)
                 ),
        'services', jsonb_build_object(
                      'walking',     (p_mode = 'walk'),
                      'wheelchair',  (p_mode = 'wheelchair'),
                      'electricVan', (p_mode = 'van')
                    )
      )
    );

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5) خروجی نهایی JSON
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'steps',            v_steps,
    'sahns',            v_sahns,
    'viaPoints',        v_via_points,
    'estimatedMinutes', v_estimated_min,
    'distanceMeters',   v_distance_m,
    'source',           p_source
  );
END;

BEGIN
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 0) پاک کردن یال‌های قبلی همین طبقه
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  DELETE FROM routing_edges_static
  WHERE floor = p_floor;
	ALTER SEQUENCE routing_edges_static_id_seq RESTART WITH 1;


  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1) یال‌های داخل هر area (intra-area visibility)
  --    این همان کاری است که دستی انجام دادی و مشکل connectivity را حل کرد.
  --    برای هر دو نود در یک area روی همان floor، یک یال (یک‌طرفه) می‌سازیم.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  INSERT INTO routing_edges_static (floor, src, dst, geom, base_cost, door_id)
  SELECT
    p_floor                                       AS floor,
    n1.id                                         AS src,
    n2.id                                         AS dst,
    ST_MakeLine(n1.geom, n2.geom)                AS geom,
    ST_Distance(n1.geom, n2.geom)::numeric       AS base_cost,
    NULL::bigint                                 AS door_id
  FROM routing_nodes n1
  JOIN routing_nodes n2
    ON n1.floor   = n2.floor
   AND n1.area_id = n2.area_id
   AND n1.id     < n2.id          -- فقط یک یال، معکوسش لازم نیست
  WHERE n1.floor = p_floor;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2) یال‌های عبور از درب (door → از from_area به to_area)
  --    بر اساس door_access_points و routing_nodes
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  INSERT INTO routing_edges_static (floor, src, dst, geom, base_cost, door_id)
  SELECT
    d.floor                                             AS floor,
    n_from.id                                          AS src,
    n_to.id                                            AS dst,
    ST_MakeLine(n_from.geom, n_to.geom)                AS geom,
    GREATEST(ST_Distance(n_from.geom, n_to.geom), 0.5) AS base_cost,
    d.id                                               AS door_id
  FROM doors d
  JOIN door_access_points dap
    ON dap.door_id = d.id
  JOIN routing_nodes n_from
    ON n_from.ref_table = 'doors'
   AND n_from.ref_id    = d.id
   AND n_from.area_id   = dap.from_area
   AND n_from.floor     = d.floor
  JOIN routing_nodes n_to
    ON n_to.ref_table   = 'doors'
   AND n_to.ref_id      = d.id
   AND n_to.area_id     = dap.to_area
   AND n_to.floor       = d.floor
  WHERE
    d.floor = p_floor;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3) گزارش تعداد یال‌های ساخته‌شده برای دیباگ
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  RAISE NOTICE 'routing_edges_static built for floor %, edges: %',
    p_floor,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM routing_edges_static WHERE floor = p_floor);
END;

  ), calc AS (

      d.id,

      COALESCE(
        af.id,
        ab.area1_id

      COALESCE(
        CASE
          WHEN at.id IS NOT NULL

          ELSE at.id

        af.id,
        ab.area2_id

    FROM doors d
    CROSS JOIN params prm

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT ST_LineInterpolatePoint(d.geom, prm.alpha) AS p_from_geom
    ) p_from

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT ST_LineInterpolatePoint(d.geom, prm.beta) AS p_to_geom
    ) p_to

    -- نزدیک‌ترین area برای سمت from (به‌جز پله/رمپ/آسانسور)
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT a.*
      FROM areas a
      WHERE a.floor = d.floor
        AND a.area_type NOT IN ('stair_area','ramp_area','elevator_area')
        AND ST_DWithin(a.geom, p_from.p_from_geom, prm.rad_pt)
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN ST_Intersects(a.geom, p_from.p_from_geom) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        ST_Distance(a.geom, p_from.p_from_geom)
      LIMIT 1
    ) af ON TRUE

    -- نزدیک‌ترین area برای سمت to (به‌جز پله/رمپ/آسانسور)
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT a.*
      FROM areas a
      WHERE a.floor = d.floor
        AND a.area_type NOT IN ('stair_area','ramp_area','elevator_area')
        AND ST_DWithin(a.geom, p_to.p_to_geom, prm.rad_pt)
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN ST_Intersects(a.geom, p_to.p_to_geom) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        ST_Distance(a.geom, p_to.p_to_geom)
      LIMIT 1
    ) at ON TRUE

    -- دو area غالب بر اساس بیشترین intersection با بافر درب

          a.id,

            (mod(

            ))::double precision AS bearing_to_poi_deg,

            -- bearing از POI به کاربر (برای تشخیص سمت کاربر نسبت به POI)
            (mod(

            ))::double precision AS bearing_poi_to_user_deg

    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(v_row.content_media, '[]'::jsonb)) AS elem

    LIMIT 1;

        'status', 'OK',
        'poi_id', v_row.poi_id,
        'floor',  v_row.floor,

        'distance_m', v_row.distance_m,
        'bearing_to_poi_deg', v_row.bearing_to_poi_deg,
        'angle_diff_deg', v_row.angle_diff_deg,

        'content', jsonb_build_object(

        ),

-- ========== 1) POI ها ==========
  SELECT
    'poi_points'::text AS entity_table,
    p.id               AS entity_id,
    ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326) AS geom_4326,
    p.floor,
    fn_i18n_label('poi_points', p.id, 'name', p_lang, 'fa') AS name,
    fn_i18n_label('poi_points', p.id, 'desc', p_lang, 'fa') AS description,

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->>'group',
      cat.level1_code,
      m.default_group,
      'poi'
    ) AS "group",

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->>'sub_group',
      cat.level2_code,
      m.default_subgroup,
      p.poi_type::text
    ) AS "subGroup",

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->>'sub_group_value',
      cat.leaf_code,
      'poi-' || p.id
    ) AS "subGroupValue",

    cat.level3_code AS category_level3,
    cat.level4_code AS category_level4,
    cat.level5_code AS category_level5,
    cat.leaf_code   AS category_leaf,

    COALESCE(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.attrs->'types')
      ),
      m.default_types,
      ARRAY[]::text[]
    ) AS types,

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->'services',
      m.default_services,
      '{}'::jsonb
    ) AS services,

    CASE
      WHEN p.attrs ? 'gender' THEN
        CASE p.attrs->>'gender'
          WHEN 'male'   THEN 'male'
          WHEN 'female' THEN 'female'
          ELSE 'both'
        END
      WHEN m.default_gender IS NOT NULL THEN m.default_gender
      ELSE 'both'
    END AS gender,

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->>'nodeFunction',
      m.default_node_function,
      'poi'
    ) AS nodeFunction,

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->'restrictedTimes',
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS restrictedTimes,

    ST_Y(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)) AS latitude,
    ST_X(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)) AS longitude,

    p.attrs->'gpsMeta' AS gpsMeta,

    now() AS "timestamp",

    COALESCE(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.attrs->'transportModes')
      ),
      m.default_transport_modes,
      ARRAY[]::text[]
    ) AS transportModes

  FROM poi_points p
  LEFT JOIN feature_group_mappings m
    ON m.entity_table = 'poi_points'
   AND m.feature_key  = p.poi_type::text
  LEFT JOIN categories c_leaf
    ON c_leaf.id = m.category_leaf_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_category_path(c_leaf.id) cat
    ON TRUE

  UNION ALL

  -- ========== 2) درب‌ها ==========
  SELECT
    'doors'::text AS entity_table,
    d.id          AS entity_id,
    ST_Transform(d.geom, 4326) AS geom_4326,
    d.floor,
    fn_i18n_label('doors', d.id, 'name', p_lang, 'fa') AS name,
    fn_i18n_label('doors', d.id, 'desc', p_lang, 'fa') AS description,

    COALESCE(
      d.attrs->>'group',
      cat.level1_code,
      m.default_group,
      'connection'
    ) AS "group",

    COALESCE(
      d.attrs->>'sub_group',
      cat.level2_code,
      m.default_subgroup,
      'door'
    ) AS "subGroup",

    COALESCE(
      d.attrs->>'sub_group_value',
      cat.leaf_code,
      'door-' || d.id
    ) AS "subGroupValue",

    cat.level4_code AS category_level4,
    cat.level5_code AS category_level5,

      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(d.attrs->'types')
      ),
      m.default_types,
      ARRAY['door']::text[]
    ) AS types,

      CASE d.allowed_gender

        WHEN 'female' THEN 'female'
        ELSE 'both'

      m.default_gender,
      'both'

    COALESCE(
      d.attrs->>'nodeFunction',
      m.default_node_function,
      'door'

    COALESCE(
      d.attrs->'restrictedTimes',

    now() AS "timestamp",

    d.modes AS transportModes

  FROM doors d
  LEFT JOIN feature_group_mappings m
    ON m.entity_table = 'doors'
   AND m.feature_key  = 'door'
  LEFT JOIN categories c_leaf
    ON c_leaf.id = m.category_leaf_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_category_path(c_leaf.id) cat
    ON TRUE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'areas'::text AS entity_table,
    a.id          AS entity_id,
    ST_Transform(COALESCE(s.geom, a.geom), 4326) AS geom_4326,
    a.floor,
    fn_i18n_label('areas', a.id, 'name', p_lang, 'fa') AS name,
    fn_i18n_label('areas', a.id, 'desc', p_lang, 'fa') AS description,

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->>'group',
      cat.level1_code,
      m.default_group,
      CASE a.area_type

        WHEN 'riwaq'         THEN 'riwaq'
        WHEN 'iwan'          THEN 'iwan'
        WHEN 'mosque'        THEN 'mosque'
        WHEN 'elevator_area' THEN 'vertical'
        WHEN 'stair_area'    THEN 'vertical'
        WHEN 'ramp_area'     THEN 'vertical'
        WHEN 'admin_zone'    THEN 'admin'
        ELSE 'area'
      END,
      'area'
    ) AS "group",

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->>'sub_group',
      cat.level2_code,
      m.default_subgroup,
      fn_i18n_label('areas', a.id, 'name', p_lang, 'fa')
    ) AS "subGroup",

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->>'sub_group_value',
      cat.leaf_code,
      'area-' || a.id

    cat.level4_code AS category_level4,

      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.attrs->'types')
      ),
      m.default_types,
      ARRAY[a.area_type::text]
    ) AS types,

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->'services',
      m.default_services,
      '{}'::jsonb
    ) AS services,

    COALESCE(
      CASE a.allowed_gender
        WHEN 'male'   THEN 'male'
        WHEN 'female' THEN 'female'
        ELSE 'both'
      END,
      m.default_gender,
      'both'
    ) AS gender,

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->>'nodeFunction',
      m.default_node_function,
      'area'
    ) AS nodeFunction,

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->'restrictedTimes',
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS restrictedTimes,

    ST_Y(
      ST_Centroid(
        ST_Transform(COALESCE(s.geom, a.geom), 4326)
      )
    ) AS latitude,
    ST_X(
      ST_Centroid(
        ST_Transform(COALESCE(s.geom, a.geom), 4326)
      )
    ) AS longitude,

    a.attrs->'gpsMeta' AS gpsMeta,

    now() AS "timestamp",

    COALESCE(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.attrs->'transportModes')
      ),
      m.default_transport_modes,
      ARRAY[]::text[]
    ) AS transportModes

  FROM areas a
  LEFT JOIN areas_simplified s
    ON s.id = a.id
  LEFT JOIN feature_group_mappings m
    ON m.entity_table = 'areas'
   AND m.feature_key  = a.area_type::text
  LEFT JOIN categories c_leaf
    ON c_leaf.id = m.category_leaf_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_category_path(c_leaf.id) cat
    ON TRUE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT

    v.id              AS entity_id,

    v.floor,
    fn_i18n_label('van_nodes', v.id, 'name', p_lang, 'fa') AS name,

      cat.level1_code,

    cat.level4_code AS category_level4,
    cat.level5_code AS category_level5,

    COALESCE(
      m.default_types,

    COALESCE(
      m.default_services,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'wheelchair',   true,

    COALESCE(
      m.default_gender,

    ) AS gender,

    COALESCE(
      m.default_node_function,

    '[]'::jsonb AS restrictedTimes,

    ST_Y(ST_Transform(v.geom, 4326)) AS latitude,
    ST_X(ST_Transform(v.geom, 4326)) AS longitude,

    NULL::jsonb AS gpsMeta,

    now() AS "timestamp",

    COALESCE(

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_map_features(p_lang lang_enum)
 RETURNS TABLE(entity_table text, entity_id bigint, geom_4326 geometry, floor smallint, name text, description text, "group" text, "subGroup" text, "subGroupValue" text, category_level3 text, category_level4 text, category_level5 text, category_leaf text, types text[], services jsonb, gender text, nodefunction text, restrictedtimes jsonb, latitude double precision, longitude double precision, gpsmeta jsonb, "timestamp" timestamp with time zone, transportmodes text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  -- ========== 1) POI ها ==========
  SELECT
    'poi_points'::text AS entity_table,
    p.id               AS entity_id,
    ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326) AS geom_4326,
    p.floor,

    fn_i18n_label('poi_points', p.id, 'desc', p_lang, 'fa') AS description,

    COALESCE(

      m.default_group,

      p.attrs->>'sub_group',

      p.poi_type::text
    ) AS "subGroup",

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->>'sub_group_value',

      'poi-' || p.id
    ) AS "subGroupValue",

    cat.level3_code AS category_level3,
    cat.level4_code AS category_level4,
    cat.level5_code AS category_level5,
    cat.leaf_code   AS category_leaf,

    COALESCE(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.attrs->'types')
      ),
      m.default_types,
      ARRAY[]::text[]
    ) AS types,

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->'services',
      m.default_services,
      '{}'::jsonb
    ) AS services,

    CASE
      WHEN p.attrs ? 'gender' THEN
        CASE p.attrs->>'gender'
          WHEN 'male'   THEN 'male'
          WHEN 'female' THEN 'female'

      WHEN m.default_gender IS NOT NULL THEN m.default_gender

      m.default_node_function,
      'poi'

    COALESCE(
      p.attrs->'restrictedTimes',
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS restrictedTimes,

    ST_Y(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)) AS latitude,
    ST_X(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)) AS longitude,

  FROM poi_points p

  LEFT JOIN categories c_leaf

  UNION ALL

  -- ========== 2) درب‌ها ==========
  SELECT
    'doors'::text AS entity_table,

      'electricVan',  'van'        = ANY (d.modes),
      'walking',      'walk'       = ANY (d.modes)

    COALESCE(
      CASE d.allowed_gender
        WHEN 'male'   THEN 'male'
        WHEN 'female' THEN 'female'
        ELSE 'both'

      m.default_gender,

      END,

    ) AS gender,

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->>'nodeFunction',
      m.default_node_function,
      'area'
    ) AS nodeFunction,

    COALESCE(
      a.attrs->'restrictedTimes',
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS restrictedTimes,

    ST_Y(
      ST_Centroid(
        ST_Transform(COALESCE(s.geom, a.geom), 4326)
      )
    ) AS latitude,
    ST_X(
      ST_Centroid(
        ST_Transform(COALESCE(s.geom, a.geom), 4326)
      )
    ) AS longitude,

    a.attrs->'gpsMeta' AS gpsMeta,

    now() AS "timestamp",

    COALESCE(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.attrs->'transportModes')
      ),
      m.default_transport_modes,
      ARRAY[]::text[]
    ) AS transportModes

  LEFT JOIN feature_group_mappings m

  LEFT JOIN categories c_leaf
    ON c_leaf.id = m.category_leaf_id

    COALESCE(

    COALESCE(

    ) AS nodeFunction,

    ST_Y(ST_Transform(v.geom, 4326)) AS latitude,
    ST_X(ST_Transform(v.geom, 4326)) AS longitude,

  FROM van_nodes v

  LEFT JOIN categories c_leaf

DECLARE
  tile_bbox_3857   geometry;
  tile_bbox_4326   geometry;
  v_entity_tables  text[];
BEGIN
  -- BBOX tile در WebMercator
  tile_bbox_3857 := ST_TileEnvelope(z, x, y);
  tile_bbox_4326 := ST_Transform(tile_bbox_3857, 4326);

  -- لیست لایه‌ها (entity_table) اگر داده شده
  IF p_entity_tables IS NOT NULL AND p_entity_tables <> '' THEN
    v_entity_tables := string_to_array(p_entity_tables, ',');
  ELSE
    v_entity_tables := NULL;
  END IF;

  RETURN (
    SELECT ST_AsMVT(tile, 'map_features', 4096, 'geom')
    FROM (
      SELECT
        ST_AsMVTGeom(
          ST_Transform(f.geom_4326, 3857),
          tile_bbox_3857,
          4096,
          64,
          true
        ) AS geom,

        f.entity_table,
        f.entity_id,
        f.floor,
        f.name,
        f.description,
        f."group",
        f."subGroup",
        f."subGroupValue",
        f.category_level3,
        f.category_level4,
        f.category_level5,
        f.category_leaf,
        f.types,
        f.services,
        f.gender,
        f.nodefunction,
        f.restrictedtimes,
        f.latitude,
        f.longitude,
        f.gpsmeta,
        f."timestamp",
        f.transportmodes

      FROM public.fn_map_features(p_lang) AS f
      WHERE
        f.geom_4326 IS NOT NULL
        AND ST_Intersects(f.geom_4326, tile_bbox_4326)
        AND (p_floor  IS NULL OR f.floor  = p_floor)
        AND (p_gender IS NULL OR f.gender = p_gender)
        AND (v_entity_tables IS NULL OR f.entity_table = ANY (v_entity_tables))
    ) AS tile
    WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
  );
END;

  SELECT

      UNION ALL

    ON n_to.ref_table   = 'doors'
   AND n_to.ref_id      = d.id
   AND n_to.area_id     = dap.to_area
   AND n_to.floor       = d.floor

  USING affected_nodes an
  WHERE e.floor = v_floor
    AND e.door_id IS NULL
    AND (e.src = an.id OR e.dst = an.id);

  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5) rebuild intra-edge ها برای همان areaها
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  WITH affected_areas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT area_id
    FROM (
      SELECT dap.from_area AS area_id
      FROM door_access_points dap
      WHERE dap.door_id = p_door_id AND dap.from_area IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT dap.to_area AS area_id
      FROM door_access_points dap
      WHERE dap.door_id = p_door_id AND dap.to_area IS NOT NULL
    ) x
  )
  INSERT INTO routing_edges_static (floor, src, dst, geom, base_cost, door_id)
  SELECT
    v_floor,
    n1.id,
    n2.id,
    ST_MakeLine(n1.geom, n2.geom),
    ST_Distance(n1.geom, n2.geom)::numeric,
    NULL::bigint
  FROM routing_nodes n1
  JOIN routing_nodes n2
    ON n1.floor = n2.floor
   AND n1.area_id = n2.area_id
   AND n1.id < n2.id
  WHERE n1.floor = v_floor
    AND n1.area_id IN (SELECT area_id FROM affected_areas);

END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_resolve_location(p_type text, p_id bigint, p_code text, p_lon double precision, p_lat double precision)
 RETURNS location_ref
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  res location_ref;
BEGIN
  IF p_type = 'poi' THEN
    SELECT 'poi_points', id, floor,
           ST_Transform(geom, 32640)
    INTO  res.entity_table, res.entity_id, res.floor, res.geom
    FROM poi_points
    WHERE id = p_id;

  ELSIF p_type = 'door' THEN
    SELECT 'doors', id, floor,
           ST_Transform(ST_LineInterpolatePoint(geom, 0.5), 32640)
    INTO  res.entity_table, res.entity_id, res.floor, res.geom
    FROM doors
    WHERE id = p_id;

  ELSIF p_type = 'area' THEN
    SELECT 'areas', id, floor,
           ST_Transform(ST_PointOnSurface(geom), 32640)
    INTO  res.entity_table, res.entity_id, res.floor, res.geom
    FROM areas
    WHERE id = p_id;

  ELSIF p_type = 'qrcode' THEN
    -- ساختار جدول qrcodes رو با دیتابیس خودت هماهنگ کن
    SELECT 'qrcodes', q.id,
           COALESCE((q.attrs->>'floor')::smallint, 0),
           ST_Transform(q.geom, 32640)
    INTO  res.entity_table, res.entity_id, res.floor, res.geom
    FROM qrcodes q
    WHERE q.code = p_code
      AND q.is_active = TRUE;

  ELSIF p_type = 'coordinate' THEN
    res.entity_table := 'coordinate';
    res.entity_id    := NULL;
    res.floor        := 0; -- یا می‌تونی نزدیک‌ترین area رو پیدا کنی و floor اون رو ست کنی
    res.geom         := ST_Transform(
                          ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p_lon, p_lat), 4326),
                          32640
                        );
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported location type: %', p_type;
  END IF;

  IF res.geom IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Location not found for type=% id=% code=%', p_type, p_id, p_code;
  END IF;

  RETURN res;
END;

  -- 5) اضافه کردن alternatives به main
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_main_json :=

        'candidates', v_candidates,
        'tol_m', v_tol_m,
        'max_overlap', v_max_overlap,
        'min_hausdorff_m', v_min_hausdorff
      )
    );

  RETURN v_main_json;
END;

DECLARE
  v_origin_node bigint;
  v_dest_node   bigint;

  v_status    text;
  v_details   jsonb;
  v_sql_edges text;

  v_line_geom geometry(LineString, 32640);
  v_line_cost numeric;
BEGIN
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1) نزدیک‌ترین نود به مبدأ
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT n.id
  INTO v_origin_node
  FROM routing_nodes n
  WHERE n.floor = p_floor
  ORDER BY n.geom <-> p_origin
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_origin_node IS NULL THEN
    v_status  := 'NO_ORIGIN_NODE';
    v_details := jsonb_build_object(
      'msg', 'هیچ نود مسیریابی نزدیک به مبدأ پیدا نشد',
      'floor', p_floor
    );
    PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
      'pgr_dijkstra',
      p_mode,
      p_gender,
      p_floor,
      p_origin,
      p_dest,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      v_status,
      v_details
    );
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2) نزدیک‌ترین نود به مقصد
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT n.id
  INTO v_dest_node
  FROM routing_nodes n
  WHERE n.floor = p_floor
  ORDER BY n.geom <-> p_dest
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_dest_node IS NULL THEN
    v_status  := 'NO_DEST_NODE';
    v_details := jsonb_build_object(
      'msg', 'هیچ نود مسیریابی نزدیک به مقصد پیدا نشد',
      'floor', p_floor
    );
    PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
      'pgr_dijkstra',
      p_mode,
      p_gender,
      p_floor,
      p_origin,
      p_dest,
      v_origin_node,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      v_status,
      v_details
    );
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3) تعریف گراف برای pgRouting
  --    🔴 نکته: این‌جا src/dst را به source/target alias کردیم
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_sql_edges := format($$
    SELECT
      row_number() OVER () AS id,
      src    AS source,
      dst    AS target,
      cost::float8      AS cost,
      cost::float8      AS reverse_cost
    FROM routing_edges_live
    WHERE floor = %s
  $$, p_floor);

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4) اجرای pgr_dijkstra داخل جدول موقت
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_route_raw;
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_route_raw AS
  SELECT *
  FROM pgr_dijkstra(
    v_sql_edges,
    v_origin_node,
    v_dest_node,
    directed := false
  );

  -- اگر هیچ ردیفی نیست → NO_PATH
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tmp_route_raw) THEN
    v_status := 'NO_PATH';
    v_details := jsonb_build_object(
      'msg', 'هیچ مسیر پیدا نشد (pgr_dijkstra)',
      'origin_node', v_origin_node,
      'dest_node',   v_dest_node
    );
    PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
      'pgr_dijkstra',
      p_mode,
      p_gender,
      p_floor,
      p_origin,
      p_dest,
      v_origin_node,
      v_dest_node,
      NULL,
      v_status,
      v_details
    );
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5) join با routing_nodes و ساخت LineString
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_route_nodes;
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_route_nodes AS
  SELECT
    r.seq        AS rn_seq,
    r.node       AS rn_node,
    r.agg_cost   AS rn_agg_cost,
    n.geom       AS rn_geom
  FROM tmp_route_raw r
  JOIN routing_nodes n
    ON n.id = r.node
  ORDER BY r.seq;

  -- ساخت خط و هزینه کل
  SELECT
    ST_MakeLine(rn_geom ORDER BY rn_seq)::geometry(LineString, 32640) AS line_geom,
    max(rn_agg_cost)::numeric                                         AS line_cost
  INTO
    v_line_geom,
    v_line_cost
  FROM tmp_route_nodes;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 6) لاگ موفق
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_status := 'OK';
  v_details := jsonb_build_object(
    'msg', 'مسیر با pgr_dijkstra پیدا شد',
    'origin_node', v_origin_node,
    'dest_node',   v_dest_node
  );
  PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
    'pgr_dijkstra',
    p_mode,
    p_gender,
    p_floor,

 RETURNS TABLE(seq integer, geom geometry, cost numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_origin_node bigint;
  v_dest_node   bigint;

  v_status    text;
  v_details   jsonb;
  v_sql_edges text;

  v_line_geom geometry(LineString, 32640);
  v_line_cost numeric;
BEGIN
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1) نزدیک‌ترین نود به مبدأ
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT n.id
  INTO v_origin_node
  FROM routing_nodes n
  WHERE n.floor = p_floor
  ORDER BY n.geom <-> p_origin
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_origin_node IS NULL THEN
    v_status  := 'NO_ORIGIN_NODE';
    v_details := jsonb_build_object(
      'msg', 'هیچ نود مسیریابی نزدیک به مبدأ پیدا نشد',
      'floor', p_floor
    );
    PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
      'pgr_dijkstra',
      p_mode,
      p_gender,
      p_floor,
      p_origin,
      p_dest,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      v_status,
      v_details
    );
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2) نزدیک‌ترین نود به مقصد
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT n.id
  INTO v_dest_node
  FROM routing_nodes n
  WHERE n.floor = p_floor
  ORDER BY n.geom <-> p_dest
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_dest_node IS NULL THEN
    v_status  := 'NO_DEST_NODE';
    v_details := jsonb_build_object(
      'msg', 'هیچ نود مسیریابی نزدیک به مقصد پیدا نشد',
      'floor', p_floor
    );
    PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
      'pgr_dijkstra',
      p_mode,
      p_gender,
      p_floor,
      p_origin,
      p_dest,
      v_origin_node,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      v_status,
      v_details
    );
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3) تعریف گراف برای pgRouting
  --    🔴 نکته: این‌جا src/dst را به source/target alias کردیم
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_sql_edges := format($$
    SELECT
      row_number() OVER () AS id,
      src    AS source,
      dst    AS target,
      cost::float8      AS cost,
      cost::float8      AS reverse_cost
    FROM routing_edges_live
    WHERE floor = %s
  $$, p_floor);

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4) اجرای pgr_dijkstra داخل جدول موقت
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_route_raw;
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_route_raw AS
  SELECT *
  FROM pgr_dijkstra(
    v_sql_edges,
    v_origin_node,
    v_dest_node,
    directed := false
  );

  -- اگر هیچ ردیفی نیست → NO_PATH
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tmp_route_raw) THEN
    v_status := 'NO_PATH';
    v_details := jsonb_build_object(
      'msg', 'هیچ مسیر پیدا نشد (pgr_dijkstra)',
      'origin_node', v_origin_node,
      'dest_node',   v_dest_node
    );
    PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
      'pgr_dijkstra',
      p_mode,
      p_gender,
      p_floor,
      p_origin,
      p_dest,
      v_origin_node,
      v_dest_node,
      NULL,
      v_status,
      v_details
    );
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5) join با routing_nodes و ساخت LineString
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_route_nodes;
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_route_nodes AS
  SELECT
    r.seq        AS rn_seq,
    r.node       AS rn_node,
    r.agg_cost   AS rn_agg_cost,
    n.geom       AS rn_geom
  FROM tmp_route_raw r
  JOIN routing_nodes n
    ON n.id = r.node
  ORDER BY r.seq;

  -- ساخت خط و هزینه کل
  SELECT
    ST_MakeLine(rn_geom ORDER BY rn_seq)::geometry(LineString, 32640) AS line_geom,
    max(rn_agg_cost)::numeric                                         AS line_cost
  INTO
    v_line_geom,
    v_line_cost
  FROM tmp_route_nodes;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 6) لاگ موفق
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_status := 'OK';
  v_details := jsonb_build_object(
    'msg', 'مسیر با pgr_dijkstra پیدا شد',
    'origin_node', v_origin_node,
    'dest_node',   v_dest_node
  );
  PERFORM fn_log_route_debug(
    'pgr_dijkstra',
    p_mode,
    p_gender,
    p_floor,
    p_origin,
    p_dest,
    v_origin_node,
    v_dest_node,
    v_dest_node,
    v_status,
    v_details
  );

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 7) خروجی نهایی
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  seq  := 1;
  geom := v_line_geom;
  cost := v_line_cost;
  RETURN NEXT;

  RETURN;
END;

WITH
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * 1) areaهای مجاز برای همین context
 *    اینجا هم is_closed و هم admin restriction و هم محدودیت جنسیت/مود
 *    از طریق fn_allowed_areas لحاظ می‌شود.
 * --------------------------------------------------------------- */
allowed_areas AS (
  SELECT fa.id
  FROM fn_allowed_areas(p_now, p_gender, p_mode, p_floor) fa
  WHERE fa.is_allowed = TRUE
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2) نودهای همین طبقه که داخل area مجاز قرار دارند
 * --------------------------------------------------------------- */
allowed_nodes AS (
  SELECT
    rn.id,
    rn.area_id,
    rn.ref_table,
    rn.ref_id
  FROM routing_nodes rn
  JOIN allowed_areas aa
    ON aa.id = rn.area_id
  WHERE rn.floor = p_floor
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3) فقط یال‌هایی را نگه دار که هر دو سرشان در area مجاز باشند
 *    این بخش همان چیزی است که مشکل عبور از area بسته را حل می‌کند.
 * --------------------------------------------------------------- */
edges AS (
  SELECT
    e.id,
    e.floor,
    e.src,
    e.dst,
    e.geom,
    e.base_cost,
    e.base_cost AS cost,
    e.door_id
  FROM routing_edges_static e
  JOIN allowed_nodes ns
    ON ns.id = e.src
  JOIN allowed_nodes nd
    ON nd.id = e.dst
  WHERE e.floor = p_floor
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * 4) تشخیص اینکه src / dst آیا door-node هستند یا نه
 * --------------------------------------------------------------- */
door_nodes AS (
  SELECT
    an.id AS node_id,
    an.ref_id::bigint AS door_ref_id
  FROM allowed_nodes an
  WHERE an.ref_table = 'doors'
    AND an.ref_id IS NOT NULL
),

edge_doors AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    sdn.door_ref_id AS src_door_ref_id,
    ddn.door_ref_id AS dst_door_ref_id
  FROM edges e
  LEFT JOIN door_nodes sdn
    ON sdn.node_id = e.src
  LEFT JOIN door_nodes ddn
    ON ddn.node_id = e.dst
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * 5) فقط درب‌هایی که واقعاً در این edge-set استفاده شده‌اند
 * --------------------------------------------------------------- */
needed_doors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.door_id AS door_ref_id
  FROM edge_doors e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY[e.src_door_ref_id, e.dst_door_ref_id]) AS x(door_id)
  WHERE x.door_id IS NOT NULL
),

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * 6) وضعیت مجاز/غیرمجاز درب‌ها
 *    از fn_allowed_doors استفاده می‌کنیم تا:
 *      - is_open
 *      - admin restrictions
 *      - mode
 *      - gender
 *    همگی یکجا اعمال شوند.
 * --------------------------------------------------------------- */
door_access AS (
  SELECT
    fd.id AS door_id,
    fd.is_allowed,
    fd.bidirectional
  FROM fn_allowed_doors(p_now, p_gender, p_mode, p_floor) fd
  JOIN needed_doors nd
    ON nd.door_ref_id = fd.id
)

SELECT
  e.id,
  e.floor,
  e.src,
  e.dst,
  e.geom,
  e.base_cost,
  e.cost,
  CASE
    WHEN e.door_id IS NULL THEN e.cost
    WHEN COALESCE(da_main.bidirectional, TRUE) = TRUE THEN e.cost
    ELSE (-1)::numeric
  END AS reverse_cost,
  e.door_id
FROM edge_doors e
LEFT JOIN door_access da_main
  ON da_main.door_id = e.door_id
LEFT JOIN door_access src_da
  ON src_da.door_id = e.src_door_ref_id
LEFT JOIN door_access dst_da
  ON dst_da.door_id = e.dst_door_ref_id
WHERE
  /* اگر خود edge مربوط به door باشد، آن door باید مجاز باشد */
  (e.door_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(da_main.is_allowed, FALSE) = TRUE)
  AND
  /* اگر src یک door-node باشد، درب متناظر باید مجاز باشد */
  (e.src_door_ref_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(src_da.is_allowed, FALSE) = TRUE)
  AND
  /* اگر dst یک door-node باشد، درب متناظر باید مجاز باشد */
  (e.dst_door_ref_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(dst_da.is_allowed, FALSE) = TRUE);

DECLARE
  tile_bbox_3857 geometry;
  tile_bbox_32640 geometry;
BEGIN
  -- BBOX tile در WebMercator
  tile_bbox_3857  := ST_TileEnvelope(z, x, y);
  tile_bbox_32640 := ST_Transform(tile_bbox_3857, 32640);

  RETURN (
    SELECT ST_AsMVT(tile, 'temp_block_areas_live', 4096, 'geom')
    FROM (
      SELECT
        ST_AsMVTGeom(
          ST_Transform(t.geom, 3857),
          tile_bbox_3857,
          4096,
          64,
          true
        ) AS geom,

        t.id,
        t.floor,
        t.restrict_type,
        t.valid_from,
        t.valid_to,
        t.created_by,
        t.reason

      FROM temp_block_areas_live t
      WHERE
        t.floor = p_floor
        AND p_now BETWEEN t.valid_from AND t.valid_to

        -- فیلتر فضایی برای استفاده از GiST و جلوگیری از اسکن کامل
        AND t.geom && tile_bbox_32640
        AND ST_Intersects(t.geom, tile_bbox_32640)
    ) AS tile
    WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
  );
END;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  g_base geometry(MultiPolygon, 32640);
BEGIN
  SELECT
    ST_Union(fa.geom)::geometry(MultiPolygon,32640)
  INTO g_base
  FROM fn_allowed_areas(
         now()::timestamptz,   -- زمان فعلی، فقط برای ساخت گراف پایه
         'both'::gender_enum,  -- جنسیت عمومی

  WHERE fa.is_allowed = TRUE;

DECLARE
  g_base   geometry(MultiPolygon, 32640);
  g_block  geometry(MultiPolygon, 32640);
  g_live   geometry(MultiPolygon, 32640);
BEGIN
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1) هندسهٔ پایه قابل عبور
  --   - از منطق موجود fn_allowed_areas (ادمین + is_closed + wheelchair/stair + ...)
  --   - + اعمال محدودیت‌های زمانی/اوقات شرعی با fn_entity_access روی "areas"
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT
    ST_Union(fa.geom)::geometry(MultiPolygon, 32640)
  INTO g_base
  FROM fn_allowed_areas(p_now, p_gender, p_mode, p_floor) fa
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT a.allowed
    FROM fn_entity_access(
      'areas',
      fa.id,
      p_now,
      p_gender,
      p_mode,
      p_floor,
      ST_PointOnSurface(fa.geom)
    ) AS a
    LIMIT 1
  ) acc ON TRUE
  WHERE fa.is_allowed = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(acc.allowed, TRUE) = TRUE;

  IF g_base IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2) حذف بلاک‌های موقت زنده
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT ST_Union(t.geom)::geometry(MultiPolygon, 32640)
  INTO g_block
  FROM temp_block_areas_live t
  WHERE t.floor = p_floor
    AND p_now BETWEEN t.valid_from AND t.valid_to;

  IF g_block IS NULL THEN
    RETURN g_base;
  END IF;

  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3) ناحیه قابل عبور = پایه MINUS بلاک
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  g_live := ST_Difference(g_base, g_block);
  RETURN g_live;
END;
